tests.reason: The job ships inert and never runs on staging by construction (VITANA_ENV=staging is a hard stop: staging shares the production database, so a staging run would email real members). Selection, grouping, the 6 h cap, every skip rule, stamp-after-send, the inert/staging gates and the catalog keys are proven by Jest; the standard gateway smoke run confirms the deployed build boots with the new loop wiring.
